Thinking about the Commanders’ WR room tonight. 1) Because teams play so much zone, it is actually less important than it used to be to have WRs who can beat man. This — and the elevation of WSH’s receivers in the Blough scheme via shifts and motions — gives me hope that their room might be more satisfactory than people think. 2) You see more man coverage on third down and in the red area. This makes early down success more important for a team like the Commanders. It also puts more pressure on Daniels to be awesome in the red zone to uplift those guys. 3) If it’s fair to say that McLaurin is the only guy who will routinely beat man coverage, Daniels being on the field is vital in helping to hide that issue. It’s tougher to run man vs a team with a QB who runs a 4.4.
